items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders, will monitor how he feels this week.
items.why: Rib injury sustained Week 1, Harbaugh update
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential miss opens targets for others in LAC
items.opportunity: If out, Quentin Johnston/others elevated routes/targets

items.text: Malik Nabers officially active and solid return: 52% snaps, 71% routes, 31% target share (9 tgts), 6-69-0, emerged healthy post-ACL.
items.why: Late decision to active; strong share despite limited snaps
items.implication: Healthy return validates WR1 upside going forward

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play; affects Etienne projections.
items.implication: Etienne lead but committee; reverse if Kamara surprises IN

items.text: Kenneth Walker ran for 173 yards in Chiefs debut — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter.
items.implication: Immediate RB1/ high-end RB2 in KC; full grown man per Berry

items.text: Jalen Coker big game; believe it's sign of things to come (called on FFHappyHour). Coke Heads unite; major waiver.
items.implication: Roster/ start in CAR; waiver priority

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for good offense; core four dominate
items.implication: Start the four confidently; fade others in DET

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid if overstated by 22.3 PPR: 8 carries (only RB inside 10), 21 routes (out-routed Gainwell 21-13), 7/7 tgts; looked extremely healthy. Good CLE matchup next.
items.why: GL work, route win, healthy look despite modest carries
items.implication: RB2 with upside; handcuff Gainwell less threatening
items.opportunity: Goal-line and pass-game role expansion healthy

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays would change look. Buying low everywhere possible.
items.why: Elite route % despite low production; Bears offense buy

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim.
items.implication: Could return Week 2; Mayer filled in previously
items.opportunity: If out again, Michael Mayer elevated

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Surprised not more dominant despite Kamara absence
items.implication: Committee continues; Etienne lead but not workhorse lock
items.opportunity: Shared carries/routes limit ceiling unless change

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming, would have returned if playoff game.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or limited; Bateman viable if sits

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out due to wrist injury; longer-term absence expected.
items.implication: Multi-game absence; opens WR snaps in BAL

items.text: Jaylin Noel only 15 routes on 42 CJ Stroud dropbacks.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Limited pass-game role; less three-down appeal
